The blood work and ultrasound are reassuring, but the chest x-ray shows an enlarged heart while ruling out pulmonary edema. Given your rapid breathing, liver enlargement, and pitting edema, have you noticed any swelling in your legs or abdomen that appeared suddenly? Have you been experiencing decreased appetite or weight changes recently?

REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Echocardiogram: Presence of an atrial septal defect with left to right shunt.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Eisenmenger Syndrome (severe pulmonary hypertension with shunt reversal secondary to Atrial Septal Defect).

The combination of your ASD, enlarged heart, rapid breathing, and significant fluid retention (liver and leg swelling) indicates that the pressure in your lung vessels has risen so high it is now causing blood to flow the wrong way and straining your right heart.
